name: Bright Deposits for WooCommerce
author: brightvesseldev

sections.description:
Bright Deposits for WooCommerce is a powerful and flexible solution that allows you to accept partial payments, down payments, or deposits on your online store. Whether you sell high-end products or want to provide payment flexibility to your customers, this plugin gives you full control over your cash flow and sales strategy.

With an intuitive settings panel, you can set up global deposit rules or for specific products. The plugin also handles the “heavy lifting” of communication by sending automated email reminders to customers before their balance is due.

Documentation | Support | Upgrade To Pro » | Upgrade with Club

Key Features:

  • Flexible Deposit Types: Choose between a fixed amount or a percentage of the total price.
  • Global or Product-Specific: Enable deposits for all products in your store with a single click or manage them individually.
  • Customizable Payment Experience: Force deposits or allow customers to choose between “Full Payment” and “Deposit” on the product page.
  • Variable Product Support: Specialized settings for products with multiple variations.
  • Automated Email System: Professional email templates for both Admins and Customers, including: 1- New Deposit Order notifications. 2- Payment confirmations. 3- Upcoming payment reminders (scheduled installments). 4- Fully paid order notifications.
  • Full Text Customization: You can change every label (e.g., “Pay Deposit”, “Balance”, “To Pay”, “Deposit Details”) directly from the settings to match your brand’s voice.
  • Product Exclusions: Easily select specific products that should not be eligible for the deposit system.
  • Smart Installment Management: Define the number of days allowed to pay the remaining balance and set up early reminder alerts.

🔥 ALL ACCESS MEMBERSHIP 🔥

Unlock all 19 premium WooCommerce plugins with one club membership. Join the Club

Why Choose Bright Deposits for WooCommerce?

  • Increase Conversions: Reduce the barrier to entry for expensive items by allowing smaller upfront payments.
  • Automated Workflow: Stop chasing payments manually; the built-in reminder system does it for you.
  • User-Friendly Interface: A clean, organized settings dashboard based on the latest WooCommerce standards.

If you have any issues at all with the free version of our plugin, please use the support tab section, so we can help you resolve them. We are continuing to improve and would love your feedback.

If you have any issues at all with the pro version of our plugin, we cannot support them here due to forum policies but can support them here on our website.

SOME OF OUR PREMIUM PLUGINS

  • Additional Variation Images for WooCommerce
  • Min/Max Quantities for WooCommerce
  • Preorders for WooCommerce PRO

SOME OF OUR FREE PLUGINS

  • Custom Order Status Manager for WooCommerce allows you to create, delete and edit order statuses to control the flow of your orders better.
  • Order Delivery Date Time & Pickup for WooCommerce During the checkout process, customers can effortlessly choose a delivery date and time for their orders.
  • Show Stock for WooCommerce
  • Order Status Control for WooCommerce
  • Disable Email Notifications for WooCommerce

Uninstall

When uninstalled, the plugin removes its main options (bdfwbp_installed and bdfwbp_deposits_settings).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Bright Deposits Settings to configure the plugin.
